scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @quickmeet/server" "npm run dev -w @quickmeet/demo"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @quickmeet/sdk && npm run build -w @quickmeet/node && npm run build -w @quickmeet/react && npm run build -w @quickmeet/server && npm run build -w @quickmeet/demo
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @quickmeet/sdk && npm run typecheck -w @quickmeet/node && npm run build -w @quickmeet/react && npm run typecheck -w @quickmeet/server && npm run typecheck -w @quickmeet/demo
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
